title: Reviewer CAS on live-review/rows truncated reviews.jsonl (26 -> 4 rows); make the write size-independent
note: OBSERVED 2026-10-27 15:26Z (manager): commit 3f1546c2d on live-review/rows (reviewer session_01AFoLuJhJFXH4vXJdqSrsxW, review LR-20261027T1522Z-pkg-8f9030af45e74dbd) swapped in a truncated reviews.jsonl: 26 valid rows -> 4 valid rows + 1 cut-off line; its own row was not written. REPAIRED: fb2640ef8 restores the file byte-for-byte to 3f1546c2d~1 (26 rows). main is unaffected (mirror appends; main has 83 lines). The AVAX swing row is lost; its due event will re-open. DETECTOR: a commit on live-review/rows that deletes any line of reviews.jsonl. CLOSES WHEN: a reviewer write no longer re-sends the file, and a test covers the shrink-refusal.
